title: A host label equal to the local user name does not count as a host-name leak as a plain path component, while URLs, user@host and scp-style hosts keep matching (REQ-records-006)
description: A host label equal to the local user name does not count as a host-name leak as a plain path component, while URLs, user@host and scp-style hosts keep matching (REQ-records-006)
acceptance_criteria: chough doctor on this Mac reports no host-name finding for a case path component equal to the user name; a record holding the same name in a URL, as <user>@<host> or as an scp-style host is still refused; cargo test passes with new leak tests for each of these.
